regions.name: The Crossroads
regions.description: A gibbet creaks over four muddy roads. The last lantern in the land still burns here, for now.

regions.name: Ashen Marsh
regions.description: Fog, iron, and things that breathe under the water.

regions.name: Hollow Wood
regions.description: Trees with no leaves and too many eyes. Something has been dragging bodies between the trunks.

regions.name: Drowned Chapel
regions.description: Black water fills the nave to the knees. The bell still rings at midnight, though no one is left to pull the rope.

regions.name: Bone Crypts
regions.description: Niches carved into the rock, each one occupied. Some of the occupants are not resting.

regions.name: The Black Spire
regions.description: A tower of fused obsidian that swallows the light. Whatever cursed these lands is waiting at the top.

regions.name: The Hollow Throne
regions.description: At the top of the spire, a crown of rust rests on a skull that still remembers being a king. The curse began here.
